title: Jubilant Canadian Duck Bouilli
description: A sweet and velvety Canadian dish featuring duck, bread flour, and a hint of maple syrup, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Preheat the kazan-cauldron to 350°F (175°C) with the lid on.
Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Sear the duck breast in the preheated kazan-cauldron for 2 minutes on each side.
Remove the duck breast from the kazan-cauldron and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, potatoes, bay leaves, and thyme to the kazan-cauldron.
Saute the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the bread flour to the kazan-cauldron and stir to combine.
Gradually add the water to the kazan-cauldron, whisking continuously.
Return the duck breast to the kazan-cauldron and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the kazan-cauldron with the lid and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the duck bouilli for 25 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the duck bouilli from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
